finding: Of 25 feasible joint failures, 13 had a largest positive score term from the subject unary, 11 from the D-reference unary, and one from left/right. The tested C/D ordinal agreement improved the new-frame verification, but failed the replay and permutation comparisons.
decision: Keep R171 and C/D ordinal verification as diagnostics. The predeclared identity gate did not trigger the optional readout. Retain R158 plus PCA for deployment and withhold a reliable joint-binding claim.
